findings.detail: handleScrape returns early at line 177 when no fields are ticked and no instruction is typed, before the Fresha branch at line 193 is ever reached. But the Fresha branch needs neither — it logs at line 198 that 'The field selection does not apply: Fresha data has fixed columns', and it makes no model call at all. A user who unticks all four default fields and leaves the instruction empty gets 'Please describe what data to extract or select fields' on a Fresha link that the app can in fact process with zero further input. The trigger is narrow (the default field set is non-empty, so most users never hit it), which is why this is low rather than medium; it would be medium if the defaults ever shipped unticked.
findings.summary: Fresha path is gated by a field/instruction check it then declares irrelevant

findings.detail: Noting this explicitly because `handbooks/architecture/frontend-boundaries.md` is a blocking handbook whose trigger list includes a literal `fetch(` under `components/`. Line 196 is `fetchFreshaVenue(freshaVenue, (u, init) => fetch(u, init))`. This is NOT a violation of rule 2: the component calls a service (`services/freshaVenueService.ts`), which is exactly the prescribed path; the lambda only injects the browser primitive so the service stays testable without a network — and `tests/unit/freshaVenue.test.ts` exercises that seam directly. It also mirrors the identical, pre-existing Yalla call at line 63. No action requested.
findings.summary: fetch() literal in a component — considered under frontend-boundaries rule 2, not flagged

findings.detail: The three new addLog strings (lines 198, 199, 208) are hardcoded English in an app that ships a full Arabic layer (`TRANSLATIONS`, used two lines away at 186 and 203). The adjacent Yalla block at lines 64–69 does the same, so the diff is consistent with its surroundings — that consistency is why this is info and not a request. Separately, the count interpolation produces ungrammatical output on the singular case: the e2e spec at `e2e/web-scraper-fresha.spec.ts:168` asserts the literal string '1 services in 1 categories'.
findings.summary: New log lines are English-only and read '1 services in 1 categories'
